item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[theo]).
% If Theo values precision, then he achieves success.
axiom(s1, rule([values_precision(theo)], achieves_success(theo))).
% Theo either pursues creativity or revolutionizes industries.
axiom(s2, or(pursues_creativity(theo), revolutionizes_industries(theo))).
% If Theo improves lives, then he deserves awards.
axiom(s3, rule([improves_lives(theo)], deserves_awards(theo))).
% Theo takes risks.
axiom(s4, takes_risks(theo)).
% If Theo is curious, then he either thinks outside the box or takes risks (but not both).
axiom(s5, rule([curious(theo)], xor(thinks_outside_box(theo), takes_risks(theo)))).
% If Theo gains recognition, then he improves lives.
axiom(s6, rule([gains_recognition(theo)], improves_lives(theo))).
% If Theo is ambitious, then he is either detail-oriented or values precision, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([ambitious(theo)], xor(detail_oriented(theo), values_precision(theo)))).
% Theo is either detail-oriented and values precision, or he is curious, but not both.
axiom(s8, xor(and(detail_oriented(theo), values_precision(theo)), curious(theo))).
% Theo does not deserve awards.
axiom(s9, not(deserves_awards(theo))).
% If someone pursues creativity, then they think outside the box.
axiom(s10, rule([pursues_creativity(X)], thinks_outside_box(X))).
% Theo does not achieve success.
axiom(s11, not(achieves_success(theo))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(innovative(theo)), Status, Package)"}
